issues: 截图页面铺满全屏、纸色平铺，没有舞台、没有光，开场和结尾都只是一张网页
全页 1x 时正文 14px 级完全读不清，相机全程正视，没有空间感
右上角悬浮一个小号等宽字 chip 当标题，像调试标签
节奏前紧后松：写入结束后只有极轻的呼吸，尾段近 2 秒没有信息落点
changes: look 换成 aurora（紫夜 + 紫/粉光）：真实周报截图保留，但变成一扇悬浮在暗场里的应用窗口——圆角、亮边、背后一圈紫色背光、长投影，暖白纸面在冷紫夜里像一盏灯
相机改成自写 3D 窗口相机（布局级 zoom 保清晰）+ 单调 Hermite 样条：开场 1.42x 斜侧（rotY −18°）特写标题、窗口左上角与舞台光同时入画，笔尖往下写时一路后撤到全窗，最后微俯上移
笔尖换成 3px 深紫 caret + 柔光、只骑在实际文字宽度内，开写前 8f 在标题起点闪烁待命；人名标题长出极光紫 multiply 底
节奏重排为 150f：写入 8→57f（cue = 8 + 4.4g、每块 9f）→ 双栏 54/62f 揭开 → 历史周报 66f 起每 5f 落一条 → 标语 100f 起逐词升起 → hold 24f
去掉右上角 chip，收尾加一行 84px 标语「The weekly brief writes itself.」（后半句强调色），左对齐窗口左缘，尾帧是一张产品海报
issuesEn: The screenshot filled the frame as flat paper with no stage or light, so it opened and ended as just a web page
At full-page 1x the 14px-class body text was unreadable and the camera stayed frontal throughout, with no sense of space
A small monospace chip floating at top right served as the title and looked like a debug label
Front-loaded rhythm: after writing ended there was only a faint breathing move, leaving nearly two seconds without a point
changesEn: Aurora look (violet night, violet/pink light): the real weekly-brief screenshot stays but becomes an app window floating in the dark, with rounded corners, a bright rim, a violet backlight and a long shadow, so the warm paper glows like a lamp in the cool night

A custom 3D window camera (layout-level zoom keeps text sharp) on a monotone Hermite spline: it opens on a 1.42x oblique close-up of the title (rotY -18°) with the window corner and stage light in frame, pulls back as the caret writes down the page to the full window, then tilts slightly and lifts
The caret is now a 3px deep-violet bar with a soft glow that stays within the actual text width and blinks at the title start for 8f before writing; member-name headings grow a violet multiply wash
Rhythm rebuilt to 150f: writing 8-57f (cue = 8 + 4.4g, 9f per block), side rails reveal at 54/62f, past weeks drop in every 5f from 66f, the tagline rises word by word from 100f, then a 24f hold
The corner chip is gone; the shot ends on an 84px tagline "The weekly brief writes itself." (second half in accent) aligned to the window's left edge, making the last frame a product poster
